description: This file defines an interface class 'IFactories' within the WPEFramework::PluginHost namespace, which provides factory methods for creating web-related objects such as Request, Response, FileBody, and JSONRPC. It also includes licensing information and namespace encapsulation.

classes.name: IFactories
classes.description: An interface class providing factory methods for web request handling and JSON-RPC messaging in the WPEFramework plugin host.

methods.name: Assign
methods.description: Assigns an instance to the static reference of IFactories.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns a reference to the singleton instance of IFactories.

methods.name: IsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the IFactories instance is available.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy to a Web::Request object.

methods.name: Response
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy to a Web::Response object.

methods.name: FileBody
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy to a Web::FileBody object.

methods.name: JSONRPC
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy to a Web::JSONBodyType<Core::JSONRPC::Message> object.
